title: [Job Queue] Don't cancel the executed task when scheduling the next run
summary: When the Job Queue schedules the next run after a successful recurring run or a retry, it no longer sends a platform cancel for the task that is still executing. System Task ID is still cleared, and other task IDs are still cancelled, which cuts redundant cancellation notifications.
key_points: Executed tasks are no longer cancelled when the next run is scheduled
New internal FinalizeRun overload preserves the executed task ID
CancelTask still clears System Task ID but skips platform cancel for executing tasks
Replacement tasks and other scenarios still cancelled as before
No public API or event signature changes
